title: JSON to TypeScript
description: Convert JSON to TypeScript interfaces — nested objects, arrays, unions and optional detection.
howto: Copy the interfaces or download types.ts.

faqs.a: Each nested object becomes its own named interface (ParentKey + suffix), so the output compiles cleanly.
From their items — a single type when uniform, a union when mixed, unknown[] when empty.
Fields whose sample value is null become optional (field?: type | null) since the real type is unknown.
Yes — valid TypeScript with no dependencies. Run tsc --noEmit to verify.
